issues.description: The exercise text asks students to implement `addGuestStudents(String)` (problem_statement.md), but the UML diagram specifies `addGuestStudents(int): void` and the reference solution implements `addGuestStudents(int)`. This parameter type mismatch can lead students to implement a String-based method signature that will not match the expected API/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the task text to require `addGuestStudents(int)` instead of `addGuestStudents(String)` (and keep it consistent with the UML), or if String input is intended, update the UML diagram and reference solution to use `addGuestStudents(String)` consistently.
